notes.title: Push the Crate: Remastered Edition now available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Push the Crate: Remastered Edition now available![/h1]

A new update for Push the Crate is now available and turns it into the Remastered Edition featuring:
[b][list]

Have fun puzzle trough the new version of Push the Crate.

notes.title: New Beta Version
notes.notes:
Hello,

a new Beta Version for Push The Crate is now available in the new publicBeta branch.

The new version changes how Achivements are triggered and from the current log files - all achievments get triggered.

Please take a short look into this beta (only ~25mb update size) and report your experience.

notes.title: Update v30300 released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Polygon Art has taken over the development from Push The Crate as the original developer is defunct and no longer exists.

We want to start supporting Push The Crate with new updates over the next months. Please remember that this is only a small side project with low priority.

This update is a very first, little step to improve the game and please don't expect that all (of the many issues) are now resolved. Please report your current experience with the game.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[code]
[list]
    [*]Updated to Unreal Engine 4.16
    [*]Reworked Steamwork Integration
    [*]Updated Achievement integration
    [*]Updated Foliage distance
    [*]Updated several Materials to UE 4.16 standards
    [*]Fixed several code warnings and errors
[/list]	
[/code]

notes.title: Archivement fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I worked the last days hard on a fix for the broken achievements and tried to figure out what might cause the problems. And unfortunately I can't find any problems.

All archivements are triggered the same way, the setup for each of the is as it should be but for some reasons some archivements won't work for some people.

As visible in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/496610/achievements/] global stats[/url] for some players all archivements are working fine, ppdating the Unreal Enging didn't solve the problem. I have absolutly no idea what's the reason for this strange behaviour.

I'll try to fix this in the future and hope another Unreal Engine or Steamworks update can fix this, but right now I'm clueless.

I'm very sorry for this! There will be a sale in the next weeks and the price will be lowered because these features aren't working as they should!
